advert_text:
Who we are
Chadwick Geotechnics is a leading supplier of testing, and engineering services to the Geotechnical, Civil and Environmental Engineering disciplines across the Eastern Seaboard, Australia and the Asia Pacific Region.
We specialise in site investigations, geotechnical design, environmental assessments, and ground engineering solutions, and we offer a comprehensive range of instrumentation and monitoring services. Our clients come from a diverse range of sectors, including construction, infrastructure, mining, energy, and government.
The opportunity
We have a great opportunity for a motivated and reliable Field and Laboratory Technician in a six-month fixed-term role supporting our technical team across laboratory testing and field investigation activities.
This role suits someone who enjoys practical, hands-on work and is keen to develop their technical skills in the geotechnical industry. You will work both independently and as part of a team, receiving training and guidance to undertake field and laboratory services safely, accurately and professionally.
What you’ll be doing
Laboratory Testing 
- Assist with laboratory testing in accordance with procedures, safety requirements and relevant Australian and international standards.
- Develop knowledge of laboratory practices and operations.
- Complete quality assurance testing, maintain accurate records and report results.
- Keep laboratory areas and equipment clean, organised and safe.
- Work effectively both independently and as part of a team, managing tasks and time efficiently.
Field Testing
- Undertake training in field equipment and testing procedures.
- Assist with supervised field investigations, following directions and working safely and professionally.
- Complete field records and testing documentation accurately.
- Travel to project sites as required.
Quality Assurance 
- Conduct laboratory and field quality assurance testing in accordance with relevant standards, procedures and codes of practice.
- Support consistent quality system application and promptly report issues, non-conformances or equipment concerns.
Health & Safety 
- Comply with company HSE policies, procedures, SWMS and safe operating requirements.
- Complete all required training, inductions and health assessments.
- Hold a valid Construction Industry Card (CIC) and driver’s licence.
- Wear and maintain company-provided PPE.
- Work safely, report hazards and incidents promptly, and use equipment responsibly.
- Support environmentally sustainable work practices.
What you’ll bring
- Sound literacy and numeracy skills.
- Practical, hands-on approach and willingness to learn laboratory and field-testing procedures.
- Ability to follow instructions and established procedures accurately.
- Effective team-working and independent working skills.
- Strong time management, organisational and communication skills.
- Professional, reliable and safety-conscious attitude.
- Commitment to quality and environmental standards.
- Comfortable working outdoors, in laboratories and on active project sites.
Essential Requirements 
- A valid driver’s licence for the vehicle you are operating.
- A Construction Industry Card (CIC).
- Willingness to complete all required company, project and industry training.
Why join Chad Geotechnics? 
Chadwick Geotechnics is more than just a place to work. Here, your contributions make a difference as you collaborate with experts on some of Victoria’s and Australia’s most interesting and meaningful projects, including major infrastructure, land development and renewable energy initiatives.
We embrace diversity and inclusion and offer an environment in which new ideas, innovation, technical rigour, and achievement of results are rewarded. We implement sustainability into how we operate and are committed to taking action to respond to the global and local sustainability challenges facing our natural environment and society.
Want to join the team? Apply Now!
For further information on Chadwick Geotechnics, go to https://www.chadwickgeotechnics.com.au. For more information on our careers go to www.tonkintaylor.co.nz/careers.
Chadwick Geotechnics is committed to providing equal opportunities, and a work environment which is inclusive of all. We encourage people from diverse backgrounds to apply, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.
cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, and I'd like to start in laboratory and field testing. Your Dandenong team does laboratory testing and field investigations for geotechnical and civil projects, and that's the kind of technician work I want to get into.

In the diploma I studied the AS 1289 soil testing standards and kept technical records as part of the civil design work. On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and wrote up the results. I have a Victorian driver's licence and a White Card.

I can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
